overview: A hybrid air-to-ground open shooter: fly a strike jet or attack helicopter over a bounded theater, land or switch to a hovercraft, clear enemy outposts, then extract — or push the next sector for a multiplier.
features: Main menu with After-Action Logs, Missions, Briefing Room, and Leaderboard
Six bounded theaters with Daytime, Nighttime, and Partly Cloudy conditions
F-27 Viper strike jet and AH-9 Spectre attack helicopter, plus hovercraft and on-foot combat
Arcade loop: drop in, clear sectors, extract or continue for multipliers
Client-side combat with a single authenticated canister write on extract
After-action logs and a capped public leaderboard
